purpose: Teach: 同名/気配り/調査官/貸借/割当/局員/上半期/釈明

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同名の競合がいないか確認しろ
lines.en: Make sure we don't have any competitors with the same name as us.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Direct gaze. No softening — this is a task, not a question. Moves to the next item before Kenji can respond.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様には気配りを忘れるな
lines.en: Understood. And don't forget to take care of our key clients.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Slight nod on 「はい」. Absorbs the instruction without hesitation. His tone mirrors Hiroshi's efficiency — professional, attentive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、外部調査官の指摘事項に対応しろ
lines.style: Sharp, economical phrasing. Brief pause after the opening — letting weight settle. Not angry, but non-negotiable. Eyes on Kenji.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。施設の貸借契約を更新しております
lines.en: Understood. We're in the process of renewing our facility lease agreement.
lines.style: Calm status update. Speaks with quiet confidence — he has this handled. No defensiveness, just competence. Slight forward lean shows engagement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の業務割当を見直せ
lines.style: Decisive, abbreviated. No elaboration — Hiroshi trusts Kenji to understand the priority. Tone is firm but not harsh. Moving through the checklist with control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。郵便局員さんに集荷をお願いしました
lines.en: Understood. I've already requested pickup from the postal office.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact confirmation. Slightly quicker pace — showing he's already ahead of the curve. Efficient, unbothered. Small relief in his posture that this one is done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、上半期の決算を急げ
lines.style: Urgent undertone without raising volume. Slight sharpness on 「急げ」. This carries weight — time-sensitive. Eyes hard, jaw set. Not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への釈明文書を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared an explanatory statement for our key clients.
lines.style: Closing statement with steady resolve. Slightly slower pace — acknowledging this is the final task. Calm but alert, showing he's managed the downstream implications. Meets Hiroshi's gaze.
